fieldcraft_basics.name: Fieldcraft Basics
fieldcraft_basics.description: You have found a useful natural material. Tools, terrain, and time can turn such finds into practical work.

riverside_clay.name: Riverbank Clay
riverside_clay.description: Fine river clay can become vessels, tiles, and other fired work when a suitable craft is available.

rose_quartz.name: Rose Quartz Prospect
rose_quartz.description: A rough crystal can be appraised, cut at a lapidary station, displayed, traded, gifted, or fitted as an ornament.

lapidary_work.name: Lapidary Work
lapidary_work.description: A finished ornamental stone is both a valuable social gift and a modular equipment component.

sunken_lake.name: The Sunken Lake
sunken_lake.description: Miners broke through into water no map accounted for. Whatever lives down there, if anything does, has never been counted either.
